$shared.description: Variables that apply to every environment; an environment's own value wins.

Auth.description: OAuth2 configurations by name. A request uses one as {{$auth.token("name")}} or {{$auth.idToken("name")}}; the private file's fields win over the public file's.

Acquire Automatically.description: Accepted; apic fetches a token when a request needs one.

Auth URL.description: The authorization endpoint, for Authorization Code.

Client Credentials.description: How the client authenticates at the token endpoint. Default in body.

Client Secret.description: The client secret; keep it in http-client.private.env.json.

Custom Request Parameters.description: Extra parameters. apic sends audience; others are reported by apic validate.

Device Auth URL.description: The device authorization endpoint, for Device Authorization.

Grant Type.description: The grant. Implicit is refused; Authorization Code runs with PKCE.

PKCE.description: Accepted; apic always uses PKCE for Authorization Code.

Password.description: For the Password grant; keep it in http-client.private.env.json.

Redirect URL.description: Where the provider sends the browser back, for Authorization Code: http://localhost:<port>/<path>, where apic listens.

Use ID Token.description: $auth.token gives the ID token rather than the access token.

additionalProperties.description: One OAuth2 configuration. String fields may hold {{placeholders}}.

security.description: JetBrains HTTP Client's Security block. Not a variable. apic reads its Auth configurations.

clientCertificate.description: The client certificate: a PEM path, or an object with `path` and `keyPath`.

format.description: Accepted for compatibility; apic reads PEM only.

keyPath.description: PEM private key; defaults to path.

hasCertificatePassphrase.description: The key is encrypted. apic cannot prompt for a passphrase and refuses such a key.

verifyHostCertificate.description: Verify the server's certificate. Default true.

sslConfiguration.description: JetBrains HTTP Client's TLS block: a client certificate to present and whether to verify the server. Not a variable. Paths are relative to the project root.

value.description: A variable value. Non-strings are converted to text when substituted.

title: http-client.env.json
description: Per-environment variables for .http files, the format shared by JetBrains HTTP Client, kulala.nvim, httpyac and apic. The same shape is used by http-client.private.env.json, which holds secrets and is gitignored.
